questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments. One of them may contain an adverbial usage error. Select the option that has the segment with the error. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.

Mrs. Arunima / speaks / Telugu well.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the placement of the adverb "**well**" in the phrase "**speaks Telugu well**."
 
• Typically, adverbs of manner like** "well" **should follow the verb they modify.
 
• In this case, however, the given sentence "**speaks Telugu well**" is grammatically correct, as the adverb** "well"** correctly follows the verb **"speaks"** and the object "Telugu".
 
• Thus, there is no adverbial usage error in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mrs. Arunima speaks Telugu **well**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Mrs. Arunima"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 2: "speaks"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 4: "Telugu well"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.

• The correct phrase should be "**a successful raid**".

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ today will be cloudy and humid.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noun "**weather**" refers to the atmospheric conditions at a particular time and place.
 
• The sentence is describing the atmospheric conditions for today, so the appropriate word to use is "**weather**".
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The **weather**__ today will be cloudy and humid."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Option 3: "wither"** is incorrect because wither means to become dry and shriveled.
 
• **Option 4: "whether"** is incorrect because whether is a conjunction used to express a doubt or choice between alternatives.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Injustice
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Injustice"** means the lack of fairness or justice; it refers to situations where rights are violated or unfair treatment is meted out. (अन्याय)

 
 
• **Example: **The case was a glaring example of **injustice**, where the innocent were punished and the guilty went free.
 
 
 
• **"Discrimination" **refers to the unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, age, or gender. (भेदभाव)
 
 
• **Example: **Many organizations are working to eliminate** discrimination** in the workplace.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym of **'Injustice' **is **'Discrimination'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Discrimination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Equality** (समानता): The state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities.

 
 
• **Example:** The organization fights for gender equality in all aspects of society.
 
 
 
• **Demand** (मांग): An insistent and peremptory request, made as if by right.
 
 
• **Example: **There is a high demand for skilled labor in the tech industry.
 
 
 
• **Complacency** (आत्मसंतोष): A feeling of smug or uncritical satisfaction with oneself or one's achievements.
 
 
• **Example:** His complacency after winning the first match cost him the championship.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bells and whistles

options.text: Attractive but unnecessary features added to products
To take on a difficult task

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bells and whistles"** means attractive but unnecessary features added to products. (आकर्षक लेकिन अनावश्यक सुविधाएँ जो उत्पादों में जोड़ी जाती हैं)

 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone comes with all the **bells and whistles**, but I only need it to make calls and send texts.
 
 
 
• **"Attractive but unnecessary features"** refers to additional features that are meant to make a product more appealing but are not essential for its basic function. (आकर्षक लेकिन अनावश्यक सुविधाएँ)
 
 
• **Example:** The car has many attractive but unnecessary features like heated seats and a sunroof, which increase its price but not its functionality.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: An innovative development** (एक नवोन्मेषी विकास)

 
 
• **Example:** The company is known for its innovative developments in renewable energy technology.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: At a serious disadvantage** (एक गंभीर नुकसान में)
 
 
• **Example:** Without proper training, new employees are at a serious disadvantage.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To take on a difficult task** (एक कठिन कार्य को लेना)
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to take on the difficult task of reorganizing the entire department.
 
 

46:Tbde,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.

Since my friend was not feeling well, she asked me to __come over__ and take care of her.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"come over" **is appropriate in this context as it means** to visit someone, which fits the given scenario.**
 
• The other options **("come into", "come through", "come across")** **do not convey** the intended meaning of visiting someone.
 
• Therefore, no improvement is needed for the underlined part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Since my friend was not feeling well, she asked me to **come over** and take care of her."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "come into" **– This means to enter a place, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "come through" **– This means to succeed in a difficult situation, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "come across" **– This means to find something by chance, which is not appropriate in this context.
